ideas.what: If K4 (tempfuse, E7/C07) is built at all, replace the pre-registered '+-1% node tolerance' (R7) with the K2-style gate: final nodes within +-0.3% per clip vs the current F1 stack dummy, readmit and gapfill counts within +-10%, and the per-frame top-K guard from the v3 schedule verifier (K = pos-1 peaks >= 0.965 in that frame). If the dummy moves nodes by more than 0.3% on any clip, it is not submitted.
ideas.why_now: Old LB evidence, re-read for x138. The node multiplier is linear: +1% nodes costs about 0.1 x J x 1% = -0.0009, the same size as tempfuse's whole central +0.0008 (v_literature_symmetric-temporal-det-fusion_value.json). Our view-averaging probes lost on the LB when nodes rose: Z-flip -0.003 / -0.009 (probes 12/16) and axis-flip with flat nodes -0.001 (probe 19). Justin CH123's 10 single-knob LB tests tracked the node-count change, not offline edge J (discussion 742266). With lowrefine, K2 moved nodes only +0.004%..+0.118%, so +-1% is ~10x looser than what our riders actually do. New from M1: 62% of x138 FN are swaps or never-detected nodes, which only a detection-side change like tempfuse can touch. That is why tempfuse is the one planned lever worth keeping, and only if it is node-neutral.
ideas.evidence: experiments/RESULTS.md probes 12, 16, 19; CONTEXT.md 25 Sep 17:20 UTC dummy gates (K2 final nodes +0.004/+0.118/0/+0.013% vs K1); research/wf_ideas_v3/FINAL_REPORT.md §e R7; research/wf_ideas_v3/v_literature_symmetric-temporal-det-fusion_schedule.json FIX (1) per-frame top-K guard; research/browser_research_2026-09-24.md (a) Justin CH123 742266; tools/official/metrics.md (linear multiplier).
ideas.expected_gain: Removes the node-drift left tail (about -0.001) from K4. E[K4] goes from about +0.0003 to about +0.0005 public. If the tight gate kills K4, the S6 slot stays empty, which the plan already accepts ('an empty slot beats an ungated probe').
ideas.runtime_cost: 0 extra GPU (tempfuse reuses the already computed pos-0 logits of window [t, t+1]). The top-K guard is a per-frame sort, seconds per clip.
ideas.test_gate: K4 dummy vs the F1-stack dummy: per-clip final nodes within +-0.3%; readmit and gapfill within +-10%; no 'REPAIR FAILED' or 'DEADLINE'. Then R4 on the LB: >= +0.002 goes into F1, 0/+0.001 makes it a high-spread F2 variant candidate.
ideas.effort_hours: 0.3 (edit the pre-registered gate and the dummy_gates.py threshold) on top of tempfuse's own ~5 h
ideas.risk: A tighter gate may reject a tempfuse that would have scored +0.001 with a +0.5% node rise. The multiplier cost of +0.5% (~-0.00045) makes that trade roughly neutral, so little is lost.

plan_critique: Under the mine-old lens: (1) Runtime headroom revives no rejected idea. The 6 v3 verdicts that cited runtime (simview-readmit-pool, dog-missing-track-rescue, the averaged dense-dorado secondary, third-detector-heatmap-blend, two-tail-consensus, x138-budget-aware-deadline) all also failed on value (central <= +0.0005) or fall under R9. Keep the ~4 h to the 12 h limit as margin: it is what makes R5 trivially satisfied. Do not spend it on inference additions. (2) §f 'F2 = exp52' rested on time insurance ('единственный страхует мир «таймер сработал на private»'). That premise is dead: L34 <= 6.46 h covers public and private in ONE run, so x138's 7.5 h guard never fired, and K2 has 9.5 h. exp52 is exp48 lineage and carries the same DaughterNet insertion and head as F1, so it does not hedge F1's uncertain rider, and its public gap is -0.004 (E[D+] ~ +0.0001..+0.0003). Adopt the leave-riskiest-out twin from lens_private-finals (branch-B build line exp58n already in CONTEXT). (3) Measured tonight on the x138/K2 dummy twins against train GT: FN 82 of 2,127 GT edges. 50% are swaps, 23% one-free-end fragments (missing link 6.2 um vs competing 1.6 um), 6% end-anchored node misses, 0 both-free fragments. Same-frame node pairs < 3 um: 58 of 121,219 (x138 readmit re-opens no duplicate channel). So close E13/C08 (BYTE extension, under its 20% kill line), readmit-duplicate ideas and RE-AIM (1-2 re-points on 4 clips, 0 GT change). Keep pair-GBM relink-bonus ideas in the closed relink-knob class (probe 22 -0.002). Details in idea M1. (4) Read exp60 arms with the historical lab-to-LB table: 1 of 10 lab gains transferred. Only the DaughterNet insertion transferred (its p was out-of-fold): +0.0019 CONF -> +0.001 twice (#28, #35). Edge filter (+0.016 -> 0), ef_a0 (+0.0095 -> -0.001), float (+0.0025 -> 0, twice), leaf prune (+0.0006 -> 0), DivNet veto (+0.0023 -> 0), relink off (+0.0053 -> -0.002), hygiene (+0.0011 -> -0.001), axis-flip (+0.021 -> -0.001) and Z-flip (+0.011 -> -0.003/-0.009) did not. Rule: a lab-based slot decision is allowed only for arms whose learned inputs are out-of-sample on the lab clips (DeepCenter on 6bba; OOF DaughterNet p; note lens_divisions' finding that the dumped ins35 p is not OOF). Geometry arms (forkmid, linefit) are no-harm checks, decided by R3/R4 on the LB. Never forecast LB from lab magnitudes. (5) AdaBN (friend A B5, the only old item that passed an honest gate, +0.0073 LOEO on a scratch model) stays closed on x138. On the public stack raw AdaBN was -0.044 and guarded -0.0066. x138's V1284 head is standardised on unadapted primary features. Detector/TTA perturbations since probe 5: 10 of 10 <= -0.001 on the LB. (6) Do not re-add the DivNet veto that x138 dropped: +0.0023 in-sample lab, LB tie (probe 20), and it competes with the honest DeepCenter arc for the same forks. (7) R10: with N1 not triggered, give its ~4.5 agent-h / 1.4 GPU-h to the exp60 6bba extension (M2) and the K3/K3b analysis, not to new tail mechanisms. (8) R7's '+-1% nodes for tempfuse' is ~10x looser than K2's observed drift. Tighten it to +-0.3% (M3). (9) No change to R1-R6 or the slot table is needed from this lens.
